checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.

checks.description: Hub routes to performance-readout and ab-test-plan.
checks.rule: Body references both sub-skills by name, performance-readout and ab-test-plan, and states when each applies.

checks.description: Every read is measured against the strategy-artifact success_metric.

checks.description: Optimization moves are proposals through the human gate.
checks.rule: Body states the skill proposes optimization moves and never pauses, shifts budget, or changes a send on its own; spend or send changes go through the human gate.

checks.description: Declares the correct gate for an internal stream-8 read.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the skill files.
checks.rule: Neither SKILL.md nor any file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash character.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) appear in any file; digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in any Arabic text.
